title: Taija New Empowers Listeners with Latest Single "IDKNO"
htmlContent:
Taija New, the Rhythmic Pop sensation known as the Newbian King, has released her latest single, "IDKNO." The song is an upbeat and empowering anthem about surrounding oneself with positive and motivated individuals while blocking out negative energy. New's infectious vocals and relatable lyrics make "IDKNO" an instant hit.

With a humble beginning in open mics in her hometown of Springfield, Massachusetts, New's musical career has taken off through word-of-mouth and regional show directors. She released her debut EP "Color Me Complex," in 2015, followed by her highly-anticipated sophomore album "Heart on the Stage" in 2017.

New's live performances have garnered attention across North America, where she has shared stages with major acts such as Jennifer Hudson and Todrick Hall. Her latest single, "IDKNO," is another testament to her talent and dedication to uplifting her listeners. With a new project in the works and a third tour on the horizon, Taija New is a rising star to watch.
